speaker: provider

text.en: If a snake bit you: keep still, do not cut or suck the bite, do not tie it tight. Come to the hospital now.
text.th: ถ้าถูกงูกัด อยู่นิ่งๆ ห้ามกรีดหรือดูดแผล ห้ามขันชะเนาะ มาโรงพยาบาลทันที

source.note: Written 2026-10-13 from the disease-burden report. English and Thai are unreviewed drafts by the scaffold author.

notes: Viper bites dominate in both countries; first-aid myths cause harm. Clinical review required before use. This record is skipped at build until Burmese or Mon reaches status 'human'.
